scope: real profile updates/session refresh; transport errors and late responses explicitly injected
checks: edit preloads profile and discard causes no PUT
unchanged values and trimmed short name do not submit
duplicate email preserves existing account and session
successful name/email update uses returned token on subsequent protected request

expired update session clears private form fields
late response after logout cannot replace another logged-in account
